name: NetBird Server
description: NetBird builds a WireGuard-based overlay network between your machines. This VM runs the self-hosted management server, signal service and relay.

notes.text: Default settings use Debian 13; Advanced settings offer other base OS versions. Shared Cloud-Init configures credentials/networking. NetBird domain/proxy settings are required application configuration after VM settings; unattended deployment requires VM_NETBIRD_DOMAIN. Setup is staged for first boot: monitor journalctl -u netbird-setup -f.
If you use Cloud-init, checkout cloud-init discussion: `https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/discussions/272`
